result.title: What Does Anti-Hallucination Training Buy? Saying Less, Cheap Pruning, and the Rest
result.summary: Preference training is the standard recipe for reducing object hallucination in vision-language models, and each new method reports a lower CHAIR score. We ask what that reduction consists of. Every trained system is compared with its base model's caption truncated to the same object recall, which removes the part of the gain that comes from saying less; the remainder is compared with what a deliberately weak, frozen, eleven-feature post-hoc probe fitted on 500 annotated images can reproduce. All criteria were specified in the analysis code and frozen before the outputs they judge existed. For eight public methods on LLaVA-1.5-7B, the probe reproduces at least two thirds of what training removes beyond saying less for 7 of 8 methods on COCO, 8 of 8 on AMBER and 6 of 8 on Object HalBench, with RLAIF-V the consistent exception; a later public method released for both LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL (SENTINEL) meets the same bar on both. On our own DPO checkpoints the accounting holds on Qwen2.5-VL but fails on InternVL2.5 on COCO (2 of 4 training designs). At matched recall, the base model plus the probe beats truncation for 8 of 9 LLaVA-1.5 systems on COCO and 9 of 9 on AMBER, on the two newer backbones, and when realized as actual sentence deletion. The same measure prices training signals: DPO on the model's own samples labelled by the probe or by an object-level CLIP score recovers 0.70 and 0.87 of the beyond-brevity gain of ground-truth-labelled DPO on Qwen2.5-VL (the probe 0.73 on InternVL2.5), both beat length-matched random labels, and CLIP labels buy more than probe labels on COCO. Human judgements show that the sentences the probe deletes are wrong more often than those truncation would delete; a human check of the CHAIR evaluator's precision falls below our pre-set bar, which we report as a limitation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文拆解视觉语言模型 anti-hallucination 偏好训练带来的 CHAIR 分数下降：先与同 recall 的 base 模型截断输出对比以剥离「说得更少」的收益，再用冻结的十一特征后处理探针在 500 张标注图上判定剩余增益能否被复现，并在多个主干与自建 DPO checkpoint 上做同样的归因，同时用该度量给训练信号定价。
AI.relevance_reason: 提供一种把「回答更短」与「真正使用视觉证据」分离的归因与评测框架，可供核查 VLM 推理中答案是否依赖图像证据而非语言先验或捷径，也对齐 THINK/LOOK/STOP 中收益来源的拆解思路。
